source.symbol: Compiled gtest config selection and project routing
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
task-defaults:
    run-without-variant: false
    variants: ["1proc"]
    mozharness:
        script: desktop_unittest.py
        config:
            by-test-platform:
                linux.*:
                    - unittests/linux_unittest.py
                    - remove_executables.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
                macosx.*:
                    - unittests/mac_unittest.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
                windows.*:
                    - unittests/win_unittest.py
                    - unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
    supports-artifact-builds: false

gtest:
    description: "GTests run"
    suite: gtest
    treeherder-symbol: GTest
    instance-size:
        by-test-platform:
            linux.*: xlarge-noscratch
            windows.*asan.*: xlarge
            default: default
    run-on-projects:
        by-test-platform:
            macosx.*: []  # currently fails on macOS
            default: built-projects
    test-manifest-loader: null  # don't load tests in the taskgraph
    target: null
